confirmed_findings.claim: policyBase resolves the trust boundary from the working tree's own agent-committed acdsl/policy.json base_ref, so an agent branch can set base_ref to its own branch name, making CheckPolicy return nil before any surface-delta check and disabling the entire self-management gate.
confirmed_findings.fix: Never derive the trust boundary from the working tree's policy — resolve base once from the fixed candidate chain (or an operator-configured base_ref living only on the base branch, read via git show <resolved-base>:acdsl/policy.json), compare HEAD against that independently-resolved commit; at minimum refuse any base_ref that resolves to the current HEAD's own branch.

confirmed_findings.claim: The railroad-review lane-context design was reversed post-approval (v8.4 forces full doctrine injection instead of the plan's --no-context lanes) but the bound plan document was never updated — D1, Changes §1 and the Changelog still describe the superseded v8.3 design as final.
confirmed_findings.fix: Append a Changelog row to the plan documenting the v8.4 reversal and its rationale, and correct D1/Changes §1 to match, or explicitly supersede this plan with a follow-up.

confirmed_findings.claim: The new smine-permissions dimension and --subagents mining feature (new skills, schema additions, pipeline wiring) ship with no corresponding plan anywhere in plans/v1-2-1/, making the feature untraceable to any approved spec.
confirmed_findings.fix: Either point to the plan that authorized this (if it exists outside plans/v1-2-1/), or treat this as needing the same plan-then-implement pass the rest of the release got.

confirmed_findings.claim: The filter_untracked refactor and new .serena//.DS_Store untracked-file exclusions in verdict.sh are untraced to any plan and touch the worktree-removal safety gate, where under-counting untracked files could let a dirty worktree be force-removed.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm intent; if intentional, a one-line note in the repos-routines-ui plan's Changelog (or a new small plan) would close the traceability gap.

confirmed_findings.claim: policyBase's boundary detection (branch != baseName) is subtle enough to have produced the Critical finding and lacks a code comment stating the invariant it must never violate.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add an explicit code comment stating the invariant ("base must never be resolvable to a ref an agent branch controls").

confirmed_findings.claim: The catalog completeness sweep promised in the language-style-setting plan's Phase P1 was not verified as completed, so English literals may still leak into the non-dev UI.
confirmed_findings.fix: Run a targeted grep for remaining English literals in the non-dev UI before shipping to the non-dev machine this plan was written for.

confirmed_findings.claim: The Bash-command tokenizers in skill-invoke-gate.sh and read-gate.sh are deliberately conservative and fail open on quoting/metacharacters, carrying the same conservative-parsing tradeoff as the rest of the hook suite.
